notes.title: UI Patch
notes.content:
What's Changed
In-game UI font change.

New sound effect to indicate when zone is closing.

New sound effect when opening loot boxes.

New report tab in the main menu.


Bug fixes
Lighting bug fixed.

The bug that wouldn't show the death UI has been fixed.

notes.title: First EA Update
notes.content:
What's Changed?


Health bar UI updated.

Player camera is closer.

All gun recoil has been reduced, making guns more accurate. 

More Loot boxes on the island.


What's New?


New SFX volume slider setting.

New Ammo loot box
